pending_commit.commit_message: CHROMIUM: drm/rockchip: Change state_mutex to spinlock So we can change the state while holding another spinlock (such as vblank_lock). Also add some locking around the flush function to ensure there are no races. BUG=chrome-os-partner:55577 TEST=Boot kevin, ensure screen updates and psr works properly Change-Id: Id10fa721b090d2ff3b4ee52fec273fa076b2860b Signed-off-by: Sean Paul <seanpaul@chromium.org> Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/367602 Reviewed-by: Stéphane Marchesin <marcheu@chromium.org>

CHROMIUM: drm/rockchip: Change psr list mutex to spinlock Since it needs to be taken in the vblank_enable/disable stack, which is protected by another spinlock. This lock should be completely uncontested, since it's only taken in find_psr and register, which is only called on init. BUG=chrome-os-partner:55577 TEST=Boot kevin, ensure screen updates and psr works properly Signed-off-by: Sean Paul <seanpaul@chromium.org> Change-Id: I452e586c87bc48df43bc701b2fb9e6b0da816a53 Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/367601 Reviewed-by: Douglas Anderson <dianders@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Stéphane Marchesin <marcheu@chromium.org>

CHROMIUM: drm/rockchip: Remove delayed work to enable/disable psr There's no need for this to be in a worker, much less a delayed worker. BUG=chrome-os-partner:55577 TEST=Boot kevin, ensure screen updates and psr works properly Change-Id: Iaca811a33dc8909e4e3fb67b6a517a9061e162a2 Signed-off-by: Sean Paul <seanpaul@chromium.org> Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/367603 Reviewed-by: Stéphane Marchesin <marcheu@chromium.org>

CHROMIUM: drm/rockchip: Improve analogix-dp psr handling Remove the delayed worker, opting instead for the non-delayed variety. Also introduce a lock to ensure we don't have races with the worker and psr_state. Finally, cancel and wait for the worker to finish when disabling the bridge. BUG=chrome-os-partner:55577 TEST=Boot kevin, ensure screen updates and psr works properly Change-Id: I3febc6563ef715939d9f5fc2fe123d7d934e62f0 Signed-off-by: Sean Paul <seanpaul@chromium.org> Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/367604 Reviewed-by: Stéphane Marchesin <marcheu@chromium.org>

[autotest] Use a RepairStrategy to repair ServoHost. This converts ServoHost to use the new repair framework. It effectively replaces the now-defunct infra_ServoDiagnosis. With this change, the preferred way to make sure a Servo is available and working is simply to invoke repair() on the associated ServoHost object. Amenia/Reef: Add software charge ramp for BC1.2 & nonstandard BC1.2 Setting the higher limit of input current for BC1.2 & nonstandard BC1.2 devices than their maximum current rating results in an anti-collapse. BD99955 does not have a way to do hardware charge ramp or to detect the anti-collapse for these chargers. Hence added code to support software charge ramp for BC1.2 & nonstandard BC1.2 so that the input current is set to maximum of the respective charger. BUG=chrome-os-partner:54990, chrome-os-partner:55517 BRANCH=none TEST=Manually tested on Amenia & Reef. BC1.2 & nonstandard BC12 devices can negotiate their respective maximum current rating.
